body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW21FANbbmtTGssJ4V3eYGsXB)_

## Summary
- `early-init.el` defines `(defgroup spcustom …)` first. It takes over the old `sia-lambda` group (same docstring and link), which is gone.
- Every `defcustom` in `early-init.el`, `init.el`, `ox-cmake-ide.el` and `libraries/modules/` (except `cloned/`) uses `:group 'spcustom`; where there was no `:group`, one is added. The same change is made in the literate docs under `docs/tangles/`.
- `tools/set-defcustom-group.py` (a new top-level `tools/` folder, next to `libraries/`) does the rewrite and is safe to re-run (`--check` only lists files that would change).
- `CHANGELOG.org` entry under a new "Configuration options" set.

## Not changed
- `libraries/modules/cloned/` (vendored libraries) keeps its own groups.
- `docs/tangles/sp-appearance-overview.org` and `sp-vulpea-split-old.org`, which tangle nothing real.
- The now-empty `defgroup`s (`sp-split`, `sp-splash`, `sp-trails`, …) are left for a later cleanup.

## Open PRs that will need the group
These add defcustoms: #60, #58, #62, #50, #49, #48, #45, #43, #39, #36, #25, #23, #12. Run the script on each after rebasing. #59 and #61 touch the same files and may conflict.

## Checks
`tools/set-defcustom-group.py --check` exits 0. Each changed `defcustom` in a `.el` file also appears verbatim in its doc. Emacs is not available in the container, so tangling and loading were not run.
